ideas.title: Investigating the Minnesota ICE Shooting
ideas.description: This story would investigate the circumstances surrounding the fatal shooting of a woman by an ICE agent in Minneapolis, including the FBI's decision to take over the investigation and block Minnesota law enforcement from accessing evidence.
questions: What evidence is the FBI withholding from Minnesota law enforcement?
Why did the FBI take over the investigation?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a significant scandal and raise important questions about the accountability and transparency of law enforcement agencies.

ideas.title: Uncovering the Minnesota Fraud Scandal
ideas.description: This story would investigate the allegations of fraud by Minnesota Governor Tim Walz and Attorney General Keith Ellison, including the ACLJ's efforts to expose the scandal through FOIA requests.
questions: What evidence supports the allegations of fraud?
What actions will be taken to investigate and address the allegations?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a significant scandal and raise important questions about the integrity of the state's government.
